**Functional summary:** This 128-amino-acid protein is Ribosome-binding factor A (RbfA). The sequence is an exact full-length match to reviewed UniProt entry Q5QTY9, and it contains the RBFA Pfam domain (residues 7–110), strongly supporting the identification.

RbfA is a cytoplasmic ribosome-assembly factor associated with **late maturation of the bacterial 30S small ribosomal subunit**. The annotation links it to efficient 16S rRNA processing and small-subunit binding; it may interact with the 5′-terminal helix of 16S rRNA. Thus, its likely biological process is **ribosome biogenesis**, specifically 30S subunit maturation.

The reference annotation also reports cytosolic localization and GO terms for small ribosomal subunit binding and SSU-rRNA maturation. These are database annotations, not experiments performed on the submitted sequence. Sequence-derived estimates: molecular mass ≈14.7 kDa and theoretical pI ≈9.39.
